title: High-throughput 5′P sequencing for co-translational mRNA decay study
author: Zhang, Pelechano
materials: Phenol solution, saturated with 0.1M citrate buffer

steps.title: Harvest yeast cells
steps.instruction: Collect 1.5 mL of mid‑log phase yeast culture (OD600 ≈ 0.6–0.8) and centrifuge at 8000 rpm for 30 s at room temperature.

steps.title: Lyse cells with phenol‑chloroform
steps.instruction: Perform phenol‑chloroform extraction on the harvested pellet using the reagents and timings described.

substeps.instruction: Add ~200 µL glass beads and 150 µL LET to the cell pellet.
Add 150 µL phenol and vortex at 20–25 °C for 2 min at top speed.
Add 250 µL nuclease‑free H₂O and 250 µL phenol:chloroform:IAA (125:24:1) and vortex 2 min.
Centrifuge at 4 °C for 2 min at 14,000 × g.
Transfer the aqueous phase (~450 µL) to Tube 1 (500 µL phenol:chloroform:IAA), vortex 30 s, spin 1 min at 14,000 × g.
Transfer the next aqueous phase to Tube 2 (500 µL chloroform:IAA, 24:1), vortex 30 s, spin 1 min at 14,000 × g.
Transfer the final aqueous phase (~400 µL) to Tube 3 (40 µL 3 M NaOAc), mix well.

steps.title: Precipitate and wash RNA
steps.instruction: Precipitate RNA, wash the pellet, and prepare it for resuspension.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL 95 % (vol/vol) ethanol to Tube 3, mix, and incubate at –20 °C or –80 °C for 30 min.
Centrifuge at 4 °C for 20 min at 14,000 × g to collect RNA.
Wash the pellet with 500 µL cold 70 % (vol/vol) ethanol and centrifuge for 10 min at 14,000 × g.
Drain the supernatant and air‑dry the pellet for ~3 min.

steps.title: Resuspend RNA
steps.instruction: Resuspend the dried RNA pellet in 10 µL nuclease‑free water.

steps.title: Assess RNA quality
steps.instruction: Evaluate RNA integrity by running a Bioanalyzer RNA chip or an agarose gel.

steps.title: Demultiplex sequencing reads
steps.instruction: Use bcl2fastq v2.20.0 to demultiplex raw data, allowing 1 mismatch in index 1 and 1 mismatch in index 2.

steps.title: Trim adapters from reads
steps.instruction: Run cutadapt v1.16 with adapter sequence –a AGATCGGAAGAGCACACGTCTGAACTCCAGTC to remove sequencing adapters.

steps.title: Extract UMIs
steps.instruction: Apply UMI‑tools v0.5.4 to extract 8‑nt random barcodes located at the 5′ ends of reads.

steps.title: Align reads to genome
steps.instruction: Align reads to the S. cerevisiae reference genome (SGD R64‑1‑1) using STAR 2.7.0 with the parameter --alignEndsType Extend5pOfRead1.

steps.title: Remove PCR duplicates
steps.instruction: Use UMI‑tools v0.5.4 to discard duplicate 5′‑end reads introduced during PCR.

steps.title: Quantify transcript counts
steps.instruction: Count mRNA, tRNA, rRNA, snRNA, and snoRNA reads with Subread featureCounts, then perform differential expression analysis with DESeq2.

steps.title: Analyze 5′ end positions
steps.instruction: Run the Fivepseq package to map 5′ ends relative to start codons, stop codons, and codon positions at the metagene level.

description: HT-5Pseq captures in vivo 5′P mRNA degradation intermediates by ligating an RNA oligo to the exposed 5′P. After ligation, the RNA molecules are reverse-transcribed to cDNA using oligo-dT and random hexamer as primers. After cDNA library generation, cDNA generated from abundant rRNA molecules is removed using duplex-specific nuclease (DSN) and custom designed DNA probes. The remaining cDNA molecules are used as template for Illumina compatible sequencing library preparation (Figure 1).Figure 1Detailed HT-5PSeq library workflow
